Director IBL Message
It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Institute of Business Studies & Leadership (IBL) at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan. IBL was founded with a clear vision i.e. to foster responsible leadership, create impactful knowledge, and serve as a catalyst for economic and social transformation.
In today’s rapidly evolving world, business education must do more than teach theories; it must prepare students to navigate uncertainty, lead ethically, and create solutions that benefit communities and markets alike. At IBL, we take this responsibility seriously. Our faculty, curriculum, and co-curricular activities are all designed to inspire critical thinking, creativity, and a deep sense of purpose in our students.
We are proud of the diverse and talented community that makes IBL unique, students who are eager to learn, teachers who are passionate about mentorship, and staff who are dedicated to excellence. Our partnerships with industry, academia, and professional bodies ensure that our graduates remain connected to the pulse of the business world.
Whether you are a prospective student, a parent, a researcher, or a collaborator, I invite you to explore what IBL has to offer. Join us in our mission to develop individuals who not only excel professionally but also lead with integrity and compassion.
Warm regards,

Director IBL
Prof. Dr. Muhammad Azam Khan
